- [2026-05-08T09:09:25.805Z] FIXES VERIFIED LIVE 2026-05-08. (a) relation→love trait swap: Frank.love now updates 0→1 from Talk action and 1→2 from Stay-through finisher exit (was silently dropping before). (b) arousal clamp: Frank.arousal pre-set to 1, finisher applies -3 with clamp=true → resolves to 0, not -2. Both fixes work end-to-end.
- [2026-05-08T09:09:25.847Z] ISSUE 1 (2-click-per-action) dropped per pragmatic call — it's the TLS norm. Every repeatable canvas requires NPC-portrait click on entry. Adding alwaysAutoFire flag to bypass would need ~30 min engine work + tests + new TOML field. For pilot validation, the 2-click model works (player understands 'click Frank to continue'). Polish for later if play-test reveals friction.
